title: SZ-01 - Concept, Aim, Tone, Subject Matter

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: We are playing a fantasy delivery job in the Goldspire Territories: dangerous roads, strange magic, communities under pressure, and corporations trying to turn everything into paperwork.

sections.body: We are playing a fantasy delivery job in the Goldspire Territories: dangerous roads, strange magic, communities under pressure, and corporations trying to turn everything into paperwork.

sections.title: Player bullets
items: Concept: a corporate-fantasy delivery job that becomes morally complicated.
Aim: learn Daggerheart, build the party, protect a community, and discover what the sealed delivery means.
Tone: mostly sincere fantasy adventure, with corporate satire and dark whimsy around the edges.
Subject matter: fantasy danger, animal peril, ambush, death, corporate exploitation, undead, and memory or fear magic.
We can pause, soften, veil, or redirect content.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Clarify Concept, Aim, Tone, and Subject Matter before play begins.
